constraints.description: Every skill resolves conversation over agent over global in both directions, and real runs observe the conversation identifier without losing their start-time binding.

validation.validation_method: Exact server-full service matrix plus gated embedded-run integration test

constraints.description: Global and per-agent disables survive Surreal-backed restart and builtin re-registration; removing merge or conversation-disable behavior makes its exact assertion fail.

validation.validation_method: Exact restart and real-run positives plus two observed-failing negative controls and pre/post source hashes

constraints.description: The API exposes lowercase origin, builtins remain non-deletable, user skills remain deletable, and scoped state round-trips through the filesystem provider format.

validation.validation_method: Focused API, deletion, and filesystem round-trip tests

constraints.description: Tier 0 and strict OpenSpec validation pass without a B4-owned warning, permitted surface is respected, and phase Tier 2 remains unrun.

validation.validation_method: Cargo check/clippy, OpenSpec strict validation, and scoped diff inspection

global_rules: Use the B4 OpenSpec delta and EXECUTION-CONTRACT.md as acceptance authority because the project has no .kbd-orchestrator/constraints.md.
Report results only for server-full and transfer them to no other profile.
Do not run Tier 2 before all six readiness changes are implemented.
termination_conditions: The per-requirement verification record exists and includes literal output for both observed-failing controls.
